summary: T1 iter201 — RETEST of iter200 HIGH bug. CheckoutDrawer now passes onToggleSample to CheckoutItemCard; full UI retest in sales POS confirms the fix. End-to-end flow (sales@kainnusantara.id → Toko Kain Sejahtera prefilled customer → search Batik Mega → quickview Pesanan Sampel → Tambah Sampel 5 yd → floating-cart-button → step-1 Lanjut → step-2 SampleLineFields visible): toggle-sample-prod_batik_mega chip RENDERS (count=1), sample-kind panel renders with standard+hanger chips. Clicking sample-kind-prod_batik_mega-hanger shows sample-over-limit-prod_batik_mega (hanger woven max 0.5 yd, current 5 yd) with inline sample-to-retail-prod_batik_mega 'Jadikan ecer' link. Clicking 'Jadikan ecer' REMOVES is_sample from the line: sample-fields-* vanishes (count=0), sample-badge-* vanishes (count=0), qty is RETAINED at 5, and toggle-sample chip switches to 'Jual sbg sampel' label. Clicking toggle-sample chip to re-enter sample mode: qty stays 5 (standard woven max=5 so already at limit, no clamp needed in this scenario — but code uses clampSampleQty), sample-kind panel reappears. With cart converted to regular, step-3 shows normal 'Buat Sales Order' button (Rp 1.026.750 incl PPN 12%, NET30), submit creates KSC/SO-00006 (order_type regular, status reserved) SUCCESSFULLY — cancelled during cleanup. Meja Cutting wait-time instrumentation was fully verified in iter200 and remains unchanged (no regression risk since no src changes to cutting_service.py or CuttingDesk.jsx in this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: FIX VERIFIED: CheckoutDrawer.jsx line 390 now passes onToggleSample={toggleSample} to CheckoutItemCard, and the toggleSample fn (lines 182-187) correctly flips is_sample, drops sample_kind/sample_price on retail conversion, and re-applies clampSampleQty when toggling back to sample.

Mixed cart scenario (one sample + one regular line) was NOT exercised in this UI pass because quickview locks the cart to a single kind at a time (header shows 'Keranjang: PESANAN SAMPEL (SOS-) — hanya bahan sampel' or 'ORDER BIASA (PO) — pembelian roll/yard'), so a true mixed cart is only reachable by converting one line mid-checkout via toggle-sample. In that case the SOS banner remains and sampleMode is isSampleCart(cart) which returns true only if cart.some(is_sample) — needs code review: utils/sampleOrder.isSampleCart may yield partial-sample classification; backend order_type is forced to 'sample' or 'regular' from a single flag. Not re-tested here; main agent should verify behaviour if mixed carts are a real product requirement.
Minor: step-2 toggle chip label uses leading space (' Jual sbg sampel'); harmless but worth trimming.
